EmailTemplate.subject: We missed you at our “Ways to Optimize International Student Recruitment Amidst New Policies” webinar!
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Sorry we missed you on our “Ways to Optimize International Student Recruitment Amidst New Policies” webinar.
In this session, we highlighted how integrating digital applications and secure payments with real-time information exchange helps drive value for students, agents and institutions amidst changing regulations.
Our panelists featured:
- Larissa Bezo, President & CEO, Canadian Bureau of International Education (CBIE)
- Livia Castellanos, Vice President, Marketing, Recruitment & Admissions, University Partnerships North America, Navitas - Rishen Shekhar, Director, Global Recruitment & Engagement, University of South Australia
Here are links to the webinar recording <[[https://www.flywire.com/resources/webinar-recording-ways-to-optimize-international-student-recruitment-amidst-new-policies]]> and slideshow presentation <[[https://more.flywire.com/rs/372-QSQ-649/images/Flywire%20Canada%20Webinar%20June%202024.pdf?version=0]]>.
If you'd like to learn more about Flywire's StudyLink solution, please visit www.flywire.com/studylink <[[http://www.flywire.com/studylink]]>.
Have questions? If you are a Flywire client, please reach out to your Relationship Manager. If not, just reply to this email and we’ll connect you with someone who can help.
Have a great day! Flywire Global Headquarters 141 Tremont Street, Boston, MA 02111 United States
